L.IP

Introduction

LIPSTICKERZ is a South Korean band project under Amuse Korea, fronted by singer and actor L.IP (formerly known as Shin Wonho, leader of CROSS GENE). The band officially debuted on August 27, 2025, with their first full-length album VESSEL and the title track “Back To You.” LIPSTICKERZ introduces a “new-EMO” concept, blending elements of alternative rock and emotional pop with strong lyrical storytelling. The project is visually defined by its mask motif, symbolizing the expression of hidden feelings rather than concealment.

While only L.IP is formally listed as a member on major Korean music platforms, he serves as the main vocalist and driving creative force, contributing extensively as a lyricist and composer. Through VESSEL, LIPSTICKERZ explores themes of vulnerability, motivation, and renewal, positioning itself as a fresh entry into Korea’s evolving band scene. Distributed by Kakao Entertainment, the debut album emphasizes L.IP’s artistic transformation from an idol-actor into the frontman of a performance-driven rock band.
